description: canwqdata is an R package for retrieving open Canadian water-quality observations. The Government of British Columbia repository documents functions and examples for obtaining monitoring records and preparing them for analysis. A user selects monitoring locations, parameters and dates; outputs are tabular quality measurements for the chosen Canadian water bodies. Geographic coverage follows the upstream federal and provincial station networks. GitHub metadata states Apache-2.0 licensing for the code. A limitation is that the client cannot resolve differences in sampling frequency, laboratory detection limits or parameter definitions across providers. Current access and data-use terms remain with the data services. canwqdata can supply observations to calibrate water-quality or wastewater-impact simulations. The related catalogue EPANET model is a distribution simulator, not a national water-quality feed. No monitoring records or R package were downloaded.
